Static signatures, aapt identity/test-ID metadata, packed icons, ABI and alignment checks performed on these exact hashes. SDK1.6 addresses documented late earned-callback ordering risk; the earlier unearned ads were not proven to have that cause, and an actual reward was earned on the baseline APK.
